description: Fault procedure for part jam in reorientation unit, including post-clearance verification run and downstream trace.

box_1.text: Stop the machine immediately. Manually remove the jammed part without forcing. Inspect the part and the reorientation unit interior for damage or debris. Note the jam location.

box_2.text: Is the jammed part dimensionally non conforming (outside the accepted dimensional range for this product type)?

box_3.text: Measure the jammed part on the metrology station. Record dimensions.

box_4.text: Reject the current batch and reload from a dimensionally confirmed batch. Notify quality assurance team and create a non conformance record.

box_5.text: Is there contamination or debris in the reorientation unit that could obstruct part movement?

box_6.text: Inspect the reorientation unit interior, guide channels, and gripper faces for dust accumulation, adhesive residue, or foreign material.

box_7.text: Clean the reorientation unit interior and gripper faces with a lint free cloth and compressed air. Verify that all guide channels are clear.

box_8.text: Is the gripper jaw opening width correctly set for this part diameter?

box_9.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Measure gripper jaw opening width with a digital caliper. 2. Compare the measured width against the specified value for this part type. 3. Check whether the jaw stop adjuster is secure and correctly positioned.

box_10.text: Adjust the gripper jaw opening to the specified clearance for the current product type. reverify with a manual jog cycle before resuming.

box_11.text: Is the reorientation cycle completing within the specified cycle time?

box_12.text: Time three consecutive reorientation cycles using the cycle timer on the operator control interface and compare against the maximum cycle time specification.

box_13.text: Check the reorientation drive motor current and servomotor settings for the rotation axis. Reduce speed or increase torque limit if the drive is not completing the cycle within the specification.

box_14.text: Has the jam fault been eliminated and ten consecutive jam free cycles confirmed?

box_15.text: Escalate to the maintenance team: repeated jams in the reorientation unit indicate a mechanical fault requiring detailed inspection of the rotation bearing and drive mechanism.

box_16.text: Record the jam event, root cause, and corrective action in the quality log. Notify quality assurance team.

box_17.text: Run 20 cycle production speed verification, monitor reorientation unit for jam recurrence.

box_18.text: Refer to the reorientation unit cycle verification criteria.

box_19.text: All 20 cycles completed without jam or cycle timeout?

box_20.text: End, Escalate: jam recurring in verification run, mechanical inspection required

box_21.text: Was the jammed part damaged, could it have been released downstream before jam detection?

box_22.text: Trace and quarantine any parts from the fault window in downstream stations.
